pr_summary: Fix IDE configuration regex pattern in .idea/vcs.xml to properly capture issue references. The current regex '#(\d+)|GLUTEN-(\d+)' uses two separate capture groups, but the link template only references $1. The fix changes it to '(?:#|GLUTEN-)(\d+)' with a single non-capturing group for alternatives and one capturing group for the issue number.
environment_management: Maven-based build with Java 8/11 and Scala 2.12. No conda/poetry/uv used. Native C++ backends (Velox/ClickHouse) require Docker for building.
patch_file_cues: .idea/vcs.xml - IntelliJ IDEA VCS configuration for issue navigation links
test_file_cues: gluten-ut/ - dedicated unit test module with Spark version-specific test suites
gluten-core/src/test/ - core module tests using ScalaTest
platform_constraint_evidence: Shell scripts in dev/ directory are bash scripts for Linux
README.md mentions support for centos7/8 and ubuntu20.04/22.04
No Windows-specific or macOS-specific build requirements for the .idea/vcs.xml fix
notes: The fix.patch modifies an IntelliJ IDEA configuration file (.idea/vcs.xml) that controls issue reference navigation in the IDE. This is a developer tooling fix, not a runtime code change. The repository is a Maven-based Java/Scala project (Apache Gluten) that integrates Spark with native C++ backends (Velox/ClickHouse). The .idea/vcs.xml file is an IDE-specific configuration file and does not affect build or test execution. The platform is Linux-compatible as the fix is purely configuration-based and the CI runs on Ubuntu.
